about.label: About Us
about.title: Perfection Meets Passion
about.description: It all started with a small polishing workshop where achieving the perfect shine was our primary goal. As our clients' trust grew, so did our passion: today, we not only revitalize the exterior of vehicles, but we also ensure perfect technical condition through our professional service. Fakultatief Garage is now a comprehensive center for car care and maintenance.

polish.title: Paint Correction
polish.description: Professional paint corrections remove scratches, swirls and oxidation – for perfect gloss and depth.

ceramic.title: Ceramic Coating
ceramic.description: Long-lasting protection and unparalleled shine through state-of-the-art ceramic coating technology.

interior.title: Interior Cleaning
interior.description: Deep cleaning of leather, fabric and all interior surfaces for a like-new driving experience.

headlight.title: Headlight Restoration
headlight.description: Yellowed and cloudy headlights are restored to crystal clarity – better aesthetics and safety.

engine.title: Engine Bay Cleaning
engine.description: Gentle and thorough engine bay cleaning using professional-grade products.

transmission.title: Automatic Transmission Flush
transmission.description: Flushing and cleaning the automatic transmission for better performance and longevity.

brakes.title: Brake System Maintenance
brakes.description: Professional replacement of brake pads and discs, along with a comprehensive brake system inspection.

oil.title: Periodic Service & Oil Change
oil.description: Using premium quality oils and providing a full vehicle condition check for long-lasting reliability.

step3.title: Detailing
